title: Cooperative Cancellation
prompt:
Implement a worker that honors cancellation: it processes items one at a time, checks the token BEFORE each item, and returns how many it completed. When cancelled mid-way, throw OperationCanceledException with the token.

```csharp
static Task<int> ProcessAsync(IEnumerable<int> items, Func<int, Task> work, CancellationToken ct);
```

tests.name: completes when not cancelled
tests.hint: Loop items, check ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested() first, await work(item).

tests.name: pre-cancelled token aborts immediately
tests.hint: Check BEFORE the first item — a pre-cancelled token runs zero items.

tests.name: stops promptly on cancel
tests.hint: ThrowIfCancellationRequested BEFORE each work call — item 3 never runs.
